svg.aria-label: Oliver Maller. Smart home, network and homelab tools, built in Melbourne and shared on GitHub. I build the software that ties homes together: alarm panels, phone systems, blinds, fireplaces and KNX lighting, all controlled locally from Home Assistant and Apple Home, with no cloud in the middle.
